description: This file implements an IO timer source class that manages a timerfd for periodic timer events, integrating with a broker and executor system to handle timer ticks asynchronously.

classes.name: io_timer_source
classes.description: A class that manages a periodic timer using timerfd, integrating with a broker and executor to handle timer ticks asynchronously.

methods.name: create_timer_fd
methods.description: Creates and configures a timer file descriptor with a specified tick period.

methods.name: io_timer_source::io_timer_source
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer source with parameters for sink, broker, executor, tick period, and auto-start.

methods.name: io_timer_source::~io_timer_source
methods.description: Destructor that requests stopping the timer source.

methods.name: io_timer_source::resume
methods.description: Starts or resumes the timer ticking process.

methods.name: io_timer_source::request_stop
methods.description: Requests to stop the timer asynchronously.

methods.name: io_timer_source::create_subscriber
methods.description: Creates a subscriber for the timer fd and registers it with the broker.

methods.name: io_timer_source::destroy_subscriber
methods.description: Destroys the subscriber and unregisters the fd from the broker.

methods.name: io_timer_source::read_time
methods.description: Reads timer expirations from the timerfd and triggers timer ticks.
